name: Kaftan 010 – Royal Sand
description: Handcrafted two-piece beige kaftan tailored from premium Irish wool blend with subtle chest embroidery and tapered trousers.
details: Crafted from imported breathable Irish wool-linen blend. Features precision hand-finished needlework, hidden placket buttons, and tailored trousers with side adjusters. Designed for traditional ceremonies, weddings, and executive engagements.

name: Kaftan 006 – Midnight Noir
description: Structured charcoal black kaftan featuring vertical silver geometric chest embroidery and French cuff accents.
details: Cut from high-twist tropical wool. Features distinctive geometric embroidery running down the chest and contrasting cuff motifs. Finished with matching tailored slim trousers and soft inner lining.

name: Monarch Grand Agbada – Imperial Emerald
description: Majestic three-piece agbada set crafted from heavyweight Aso-Oke inspired damask with opulent tonal embroidery.
details: An extraordinary heirloom piece designed for chieftaincy coronations, gala celebrations, and milestone weddings. Set includes sweeping wide-winged grand robe, fitted inner tunic, matching trousers, and bespoke styling consultation.

name: Heritage Agbada – Obsidian & Bronze
description: Contemporary three-piece agbada in jet black cashmere blend accented with metallic bronze sovereign chain embroidery.
details: A modern interpretation of the timeless Yoruba silhouette. Lined with lightweight Italian silk for effortless drape and movement. Complete with tapered drawstring-waist trousers and tailored short-sleeve under-tunic.

name: Diplomat Senator – Slate Grey
description: Executive longline senator tunic and trousers in Italian super-120s wool with asymmetrical button styling.
details: Clean lines and sharp architectural tailoring designed for boardrooms and Sunday outings alike. Features concealed side slash pockets, minimalist Mandarin collar, and reinforced side slits.

name: Vanguard Senator – Burgundy Wine
description: Rich wine-toned two-piece senator set with subtle self-colored corded embroidery around neck and chest.
details: Crafted from fine twill weave cotton-cashmere blend. Breathable for warm climates with deep, rich saturation that won't fade. Styled with a crisp angled hemline and matching tailored trousers.

name: Sahara Kaftan – Terracotta Dusk
description: Warm earth-toned two-piece kaftan featuring hand-stitched bar-tack accents and relaxed silhouette.
details: Inspired by northern Sahelian heritage, cut from breathable Egyptian linen blend. Features a relaxed cut bodice, notch neckline, and tailored straight-cut trousers with deep functional pockets.

name: Royal Fila Cap – Onyx & Silver
description: Traditional Yoruba cap woven with silver-threaded Aso-Oke cotton, shaped to complement any Agbada or Senator ensemble.
details: Handmade by master weavers in Iseyin. Pre-creased in the classic Gobi style or pliable to fold in the wearer's preferred crown shape. Lined with soft breathable cotton sweatband.
